description: Experiment 2: serial vs OpenMP (strong scaling over threads). The fixed problem P on one MPI rank with 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 36, 64 and 72 threads, compared with the pure serial program. OpenMP stops at one node; a Vanda node has two sockets of 36 cores, so 36 threads fill one socket and 72 the node. The 1-thread run is the same configuration as the 1-rank run of experiment 1.
